conventions.effective_damage_body: Damage x sv_neo_wep_dmg_modifier (1.485), before hitgroup multipliers (chest/head 1.0).
conventions.rpm: round(60 / CycleTime); a cap for semi-auto weapons, not a guaranteed rate.
conventions.aim_fov: Absolute camera FOV while aiming; lower = more magnification.
conventions.categories: From WEP_TYPE_* in weapon_bits.h; WEP_TYPE_NIL items categorised manually as melee/explosive/special.

damage.note: Base damage per bullet (script 'Damage', applied via src/game/server/hl2mp/hl2mp_player.cpp:710).

weight.note: Source engine 'weight' (auto-switch priority, src/game/shared/weapon_parse.cpp:388); does NOT affect movement speed.

movement_speed_scale.note: Multiplies the class move speed while this weapon is active (src/game/server/neo/neo_player.cpp:846-850).

loadout_system.unused_xp_cost_note: Per-weapon GetNeoWepXPCost() overrides (e.g. 20 for AA13/PZ/SRS/BALC) are not called anywhere; loadout pricing comes only from neo_weapon_loadout.cpp. Detpack XP gate uses the sv_neo_detpack_xp_limit cvar directly.

damage_formula.description: Bullet damage to a player = script Damage x sv_neo_wep_dmg_modifier x hitgroup multiplier (x penetration falloff if it passed through a surface). The fraction is accumulated per attacker and added as whole HP.

global_bullet_damage_modifier.note: sv_neo_wep_dmg_modifier, FCVAR_REPLICATED (not cheat); applied in ModifyFireBulletsDamage (src/game/server/neo/neo_player.cpp:4056-4059, called at src/game/shared/baseentity_shared.cpp:2038).

global_explosive_damage_modifier.note: sv_neo_exp_dmg_modifier; applied to frag (src/game/shared/neo/weapons/weapon_grenade.cpp:259) and detpack (src/game/shared/neo/weapons/weapon_detpack.cpp:302), not to BALC charge shot.

fractional_damage.value: whole part applied; fractional part accumulated per attacker and added as +1 when it reaches 1.0

hitgroup_multipliers.note: Under #ifdef NEO the head multiplier is 1.0 (HL2 default is 2.0), so there is NO extra headshot damage in code. skill.cfg sets the same values.

limb_passthrough.note: sv_neo_hitboxgroup_pen (default 0). If enabled, an arm/leg hit is re-traced against head/chest/stomach and uses that hitgroup if hit (neo_player_shared.cpp:902-923).

armor.note: No armor-based damage reduction found in NEO damage code (no ScaleDamage/armor use in neo_player.cpp, neo_gamerules.cpp or hl2mp player). ArmorValue is only copied on spectator takeover (src/game/server/neo/neo_player.cpp:4208). Class durability differs through max health instead.

range_falloff.note: No distance-based damage falloff for bullets: FireBullets uses info.m_flDamage directly (src/game/shared/baseentity_shared.cpp:2003-2032), and the trace length is MAX_TRACE_LENGTH (src/game/shared/neo/weapons/weapon_neobasecombatweapon.cpp:1067). Damage only drops via penetration.

explosive_falloff.value: linear from full damage at centre to 0 at radius

formula_pen_used.value: penUsed = (thickness traversed, up to 12 units) / resistance_value
formula_pen_used.note: The table is named PENETRATION_RESISTANCE but is used as a divisor: HIGHER value = EASIER to penetrate (dirt/sand 0.2 are hardest, flesh 0.6, metal 0.5, glass 0.9).

penetration.no_penetration_weapons: Penetration 0 => never penetrates (src/game/shared/baseentity_shared.cpp:2331): AA13 and Supa-7 buckshot.

accuracy_model.description: Spread lerps between min and max (hip or aim table) by accuracy penalty in [0,1].

penalty_per_shot.note: x sv_neo_accuracy_penalty_scale (1.0, src/game/shared/neo/weapons/weapon_neobasecombatweapon.cpp:78); no weapon overrides it.

crouch_extra_decay_per_s.note: Added to decay_per_s while the owner is ducking (FL_DUCKING).

accuracy_model.cone_note: VECTOR_CONE_N DEGREES components are sin(N/2) (src/game/shared/basecombatweapon_shared.h:101); cone_degrees is the full cone angle N. PRECALCULATED = 0 (perfect).
accuracy_model.view_kick_note: view_kick = server ViewPunch range in degrees (x=pitch, y=yaw) per shot (src/game/shared/neo/weapons/weapon_neobasecombatweapon.cpp:899-907). view_recoil = client-only view-angle change: minX..maxX / minY..maxY scaled by hipFactor or adsFactor (src/game/shared/neo/weapons/weapon_neobasecombatweapon.cpp:916-929).

shot_manipulator_recoil.note: Extra vertical bullet-direction recoil from CNEOShotManipulator. Per-weapon sv_neo_<weapon>_recoil_scale cvars all default 0 (disabled) for the listed weapons (src/game/shared/neo/neo_shot_manipulator.cpp:19-36). Weapons WITHOUT a cvar (weapon_srs, weapon_zr68l, weapon_balc) fall back to sv_neo_recoil_capscale = 1 and sv_neo_recoil_capbullets = 10 (neo_shot_manipulator.cpp:9-10, 97-105, 135-146): up to 1.0 degree after 10 consecutive shots (shot count resets after 0.5 s without firing, src/game/shared/neo/weapons/weapon_neobasecombatweapon.cpp:986-993). AA13/Supa-7 are excluded (src/game/shared/neo/neo_shot_manipulator.h:57-58). Unverified in-game; derived from code reading only.

movement.description: Max speed = class speed x active weapon movement_speed_scale (x crouch/walk/sprint modifiers).
movement.note: VIP and Juggernaut base speed = Assault base speed (src/game/shared/neo/neo_player_shared.h:65,70).

penetration_materials.note: Index 0 is skipped by the 'material > 0' check (src/game/shared/baseentity_shared.cpp:2300), leaving resistance 0 => no penetration.

Treated as HL2-only by maintainer decision: no NT;RE content is known to use it. The engine's base surfaceproperties.txt, which defines it, isn't in either repository, so this isn't confirmed from source.

HL2 alien flesh. In NT;RE's files, only HL2's antlion surface is based on it.
